mapper.insert: insert into settlement_tbl(requester_id , title, content, total_amount,spending_category_id, settlement_type) values (#{requesterId}, #{title},#{content},#{totalAmount},#{spendingCategoryId} , #{settlementType})
insert into settlement_member_tbl(settlement_id, user_id, amount) values (#{settlementId}, #{userId},#{amount});
mapper.update: update settlement_tbl set status = 'CANCEL' where settlement_id = #{settlementId};
update settlement_member_tbl set status = 'CANCEL' where settlement_id = #{settlementId};
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_tbl WHERE settlement_id =#{settlementId} and requester_id = #{userId} and status = 'REQUEST' )
mapper.update: update settlement_member_tbl set status = 'COMPLETE' , completed_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and settlement_id = #{settlementId};
update settlement_tbl set status = 'COMPLETE' , completed_at = now() where settlement_id = #{settlementId};
update settlement_tbl set last_reminder_date = now() where settlement_id = #{settlementId};
mapper.select:
select a.settlement_id, a.requester_id, a.title, a.content, a.total_amount, a.status as settlementStatus, a.created_at, a.completed_at, a.last_reminder_date, a.settlement_type,
b.settlement_member_id, b.settlement_id, b.user_id, b.amount, b.status, b.completed_at as memeber_completed_at,
c.profile_id as sender_profile_id, c.nickname as sender_nickname, c.stored_name as sender_profile_image,
d.profile_id as receiver_profile_id , d.nickname as receiver_nickname, d.stored_name as receiver_profile_image,
e.spending_category_id, e.category_name
from settlement_tbl a left join settlement_member_tbl b on a.settlement_id = b.settlement_id left join profile_tbl c on a.requester_id = c.user_id left join profile_tbl d on b.user_id = d.user_id left join spending_category_tbl e on a.spending_category_id = e.spending_category_id where a.settlement_id = #{settlementId}

select a.settlement_id, a.requester_id, a.title, a.content, a.total_amount, a.status as settlementStatus, a.created_at, a.completed_at, a.last_reminder_date, a.settlement_type,
b.settlement_member_id, b.settlement_id, b.user_id, b.amount, b.status, b.completed_at as memeber_completed_at,
c.profile_id as sender_profile_id, c.nickname as sender_nickname, c.stored_name as sender_profile_image,
d.profile_id as receiver_profile_id , d.nickname as receiver_nickname, d.stored_name as receiver_profile_image,
e.spending_category_id, e.category_name
from settlement_tbl a left join settlement_member_tbl b on a.settlement_id = b.settlement_id left join profile_tbl c on a.requester_id = c.user_id left join profile_tbl d on b.user_id = d.user_id left join spending_category_tbl e on a.spending_category_id = e.spending_category_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_member_tbl me WHERE me.settlement_id = a.settlement_id AND me.user_id = #{userId} ) and a.status = 'REQUEST'
